items.title: Bernard Steinau Interview, 1978-08-02
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...waiting for the band out of Cleveland called Shadina Walker. Yeah. She had a group.

ctx.x: I forgot who you called. What band was that? Huh? What band was that? Well we was waiting for the band out of Cleveland called Shadina Walker. Yeah. She had a group. And Willis was waiting for the band, Hover Clay.
